# Revision: Call Function By Reference

#### Course: Learn C++ Intermediate

## Revision: Call Function By Reference

In contrast, we can also simply pass the memory address of a variable to a function. We dealt with this when learning about pointers in our Learn C++ Basics course.

```cpp
1#include <iostream>
2using namespace std;
3
4
5// function with a pointer as an argument
6void display_name(string* name_arg) {
7    cout << "Name: " << *name_arg << endl;
8}
9
10// function with a reference as an argument
11void display_age(int& age_arg) {
12    cout << "Age: " << age_arg << endl;
13}
14
15
16int main() {
17
18    string name = "Sheev Palpatine";
19    int age = 70;
20
21
22    // call display_name() by reference
23    // pass the address of name as argument
24    display_name(&name);
25
26    // display_age() takes a reference as argument
27    // so it takes the address of age as argument
28    display_age(age);
29
30
31    return 0;
32}
```

Output

```text
Name: Sheev Palpatine
Age: 70
```

Here, both the display_name() and display_age() functions take variable addresses instead of their values. The difference between them is that display_name() takes a pointer argument and display_age() takes a reference argument.

Either way, the variable address is passed to the functions, which means that modifying name_arg and age_arg will modify the name and age variables in the main() function. For example,

```cpp
1#include <iostream>
2using namespace std;
3
4
5// function to modify name
6void modify_name(string* name_arg) {
7    *name_arg = "Hego Damask";
8}
9
10// function to modify age
11void modify_age(int& age_arg) {
12    age_arg = 80;
13}
14
15
16int main() {
17
18    string name = "Sheev Palpatine";
19    int age = 70;
20
21
22    // call modify_name() to change the name
23    modify_name(&name);
24
25    // call modify_age() to change the age
26    modify_age(age);
27
28
29    // print the modified name and age
30    cout << " Name: " << name << endl;
31    cout << " Age: " << age << endl;
32
33    return 0;
34}
```

Output

```text
Name: Hego Damask
Age: 80
```

Here, we have called the modify_name() and modify_age() functions by reference. Thus, these functions are able to change the values of the name and age variables in the main() function, respectively.
